answer: Each agent registers one meadow plot with a 60-credit bond and a lotus seal self-assessing its value. The ledger taxes 10% of that value each epoch, and any raven buyer may buy any plot at that value; a forced sale burns the seller bond. The first plot is valued at 200, tax 20; the kth at 200+0.5(k-1), tax 20+0.05(k-1), so the 1000th pays 69.95. For 1000 fake plots, bonds total 60000 and taxes 44975. An underprice ring valuing plots at 50 to pay only 5 tax fails: raven buyers buy at 50, each sale burning 60. An honest agent pays 20 once for one plot and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
